text:
zoe: FYI CI for PR #933 failed on the versioned site build. Docusaurus complaining about normalized hash mismatches and one broken cross-doc link that 404s after migrate. docs-ci-bot: build failed: docusaurus build exit code 1 log: "Broken internal link: /docs/guides/auth#oauth-2_0 -> 404 (target anchor not found)" katie: looks like we migrated a heading "OAuth 2.0" and the slug became oauth-20 but the manual link in another doc uses oauth-2_0. migration didn't rewrite hardcoded hashes. naveen: can you paste the two snippets that reference that anchor? zoe: in docs/guides/auth.md we have `## OAuth 2.0` and in docs/tutorials/login.md there is `[OAuth setup](../guides/auth#oauth-2_0)`. eli: classic. MkDocs preserved punctuation/underscores, Docusaurus slugifies differently. We need a post-migration pass that computes the Docusaurus slug and rewrites any manual hashes. maria: also spotted a weird case where an example heading had an emoji: `## Getting started 🚀` -> slug mismatch between local and CI. emoji removal rules differ. naveen: plan: write a small Node script that parses headings, computes canonical slug using the same rules Docusaurus uses, and produces a mapping old-hash -> new-hash. Then (a) optionally insert explicit HTML ids for ambiguous headings, and (b) rewrite markdown links that hardcode hashes. eli: here's a minimal slugify we can use (JS): ```js function slugify(text){ return text .toLowerCase() .replace(/[^\w\s-]/g, '') .trim() .replace(/\s+/g, '-') .replace(/_+/g, '-') } ``` Use this for computing canonical anchors. zoe: also propose a quick GH Action `docs/hash-lint` that: 1) runs the slug collision check, 2) runs the rewrite dry-run and reports changed files, and 3) optionally fails if there are unresolved hardcoded anchors. Fast runtime is important. katie: yes. prefer it lightweight so it runs on PRs touching `docs/**`. We can then have a second `docs/preview-linkcheck` job that runs headless (puppeteer) and follows hashes for full verification on labelled PRs. maria: small nit: when we auto-insert HTML ids we should preserve readability, e.g.,

OAuth 2.0

not a hashed uuid. Keep deterministic. naveen: agree. I'll implement the script to prefer human-readable slugs and append `-1`, `-2` suffixes for collisions. It will emit a JSON map file so we can review changes in the PR. eli: for author ergonomics, add a short paragraph to CONTRIBUTING.md: how anchors get slugified in the site and recommendation: avoid hardcoded hashes; use relative links to headings or explicit HTML ids. zoe: I'll open PR #935 to add the GH Action skeleton and the slug-check script under `scripts/docs/slug-check.js`. It will run in dry-run by default and output a `slug-map.json` artifact. katie: can we also add an editorconfig or pre-commit hook to normalize trailing whitespace and ensure markdown files use LF? small things crop up during migration. maria: pre-commit hook makes sense. We already have lint-staged on JS; add a small mdx/markdown hook to run the slug-check in staged mode. naveen: pushing a WIP commit to PR #933 with the slug-check and a sample run against the auth/login mismatch. Will mark it WIP and request reviews from docs. docs-ci-bot: CI: rebuild queued for PR #933 (branch: docs/slug-check-wip) docs-ci-bot: CI: build succeeded on retry; preview deployed -> https://deploy-preview-933.docs.redwood.com/guides/auth#oauth-2-0 eli: preview looks good; link from tutorials/login now redirects correctly to the normalized anchor. No duplicate ids in the pages I checked. katie: great. follow-ups: (1) make the GH Action required for docs PRs, (2) add CONTRIBUTING note, (3) add md pre-commit check. Who wants to own the follow-ups? zoe: I can finish the GH Action PR and add the action to the repo. maria: I'll update CONTRIBUTING and add the pre-commit hook PR. naveen: I'll tidy the slug-check script and add tests (node script unit tests) so we can be confident about future migrations. katie: perfect. Thanks all. tagging this thread to PR #933 and closing once the three follow-ups are merged. :tada:
